newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Belgian Bank sets HK$10 bln CD issuance programme.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Bank sets HK$10 bln CD issuance programme.

text.p: Belgian Bank, a wholly owned subsidiary of Generale Bank, said on Tuesday it has signed an agreement with 10 financial institutions to set up a HK$10 billion certificate of deposit issuance programme.
The programme provides for both Hong Kong dollar and U.S. dollar issues in the form of floating rate, fixed rate and discounted certificates of deposit.

The dealer group includes Bayerische Landesbank Hong Kong branch, Chase Manhattan Asia, DKB Asia, Fuji International Finance (HK), HSBC Markets, LTCB Asia, Oakreed Financial Services, Sakura Finance Asia, Schroders Asia and Westpac Banking Corp Hong Kong branch.
HSBC Markets is the arranger for the programme and Belgian Bank will act as reference and paying agent.
Belgian Bank operates through a network of 29 branches in Hong Kong. It said it will add another branch by year-end.
